definitions.full: H7240. ribbo רִבּוֺ (K § 65, 4 ) noun feminine myriad ( ᵑ7 Syriac); — absolute ׳ר + plural רבון Kt (read רִבְּיָן K l.c .), רִבְבָן Qr Dan 7:10 a myriad myriads .
